messages:
maria: Morning handoff — I'm oncall until 18:00 UTC today, handing to jonathan after the 16:30 checkpoint. Quick heads-up: AcmeRetail has a peak load test scheduled tomorrow 09:00 UTC (expected TTFB spike + sustained QPS). Please watch the customer SLA window (09:00–11:00 UTC).
jonathan: :wave: got it. Are we expecting any cache-warmup steps or special traffic shaping from their side?
maria: They said they'll ramp from 50→1000 concurrent users over 10m. SRE ran a dry-run yesterday and saw mem pressure on the model-serving pool around ~750 concurrent. Root cause is an OOM in the non-quantized model variant when many long sequences hit KV cache misses.
alex: Noted. Is there a recommended mitigation if the mem pressure shows up again?
maria: Yes — emergency mitigation steps (short checklist):

1) Toggle routing policy to send AcmeRetail -> 'model-small-q4' (quantized) rollback: `POST /routing/policy` with body `{ "selector": "acmeretail", "variant": "model-small-q4" }`
2) Increase serving pool for model-small-q4 by +2 workers: `replicactl scale model-small-q4  +2` (SRE perms)
3) If latency > 1.5s p50 for 2 consecutive minutes, enable fallback to cached responses for prefix matches (runbook command below)

Runbook: https://redwood.internal/runbooks/acme-peaktest

Code block for the prefix cache toggle:
```
# enable prefix-only caching for route acme-retail
curl -X POST -H "Authorization: Bearer $TOKEN" https://api.redwood.local/admin/cache/toggle -d '{"route":"/v1/generate","mode":"prefix-only","ttl":120}'
```

maria: Alerts to watch in Datadog: `redwood.serving.mem_usage > 75%` (per-host), `redwood.latency.p50 > 1.5s` (global), and `routing.errors.rate > 0.5%`.
kevin: I'll be watching customer support channel and will escalate if Acme messages come in. If we flip routing, remember to notify them (they want a short heads-up message).
jonathan: Thanks. Who has permissions to scale replicas? I don't have the SRE role in the prod cluster.
alex: I can run the scale if SRE gives the ok. jonathan, ping @sre-oncall for a quick thumbs up before scaling.
maria: SRE already pre-approved scaling for this window — they asked to coordinate one change at a time. If you scale, wait 60s and re-check `redwood.serving.mem_usage`.
deploy-bot: Deployment notice: Canary job for `model-small-q4` (rev 2026.03.15) completed at 16:10 UTC — all canary checks passed (:white_check_mark:).
jonathan: Quick Q — do we want a canary-only routing test ahead of the full switch? e.g., 5% traffic to quantized variant then expand.
maria: Yes please. Start with 5% for 5m, monitor mem and p50. If stable, move to 100% for Acme (not global). Use the routing API with `weight` param.
kevin: I'll draft the customer notification and post to #acme-retail-support channel once we confirm the switch window.
alex: I'll be on standby at 08:30 UTC for the ramp and can do the scale if needed. ping me in this thread when you start the canary.
jonathan: ack. I'll take over the oncall at 16:30 UTC and run the 5% canary test at 08:50 UTC tomorrow unless we change plans. Logging notes in the runbook.
maria: Thanks team. Final note: contract SLA says 99.9% availability during launch window — try to avoid broad model restarts during 09:00–11:00. If we need to do restarts, contact kevin to coordinate customer comms. :thumbsup:
kevin: Copy that. I have the communication template ready.
jonathan: Good handoff — taking over at 16:30. I'll post a short status update in this thread before I go to adhoc watches. :eyes:
